resources.string: Classic timing method: No additional time is added after moves, game ends when either of the player\'s clock is zero.
Fischer timing method: 5 seconds are added to player\'s clock after every move.

Bronstein timing method: if a player uses more than 5 seconds, then 5 seconds is added to the player\'s clock but if a player uses less than 5 seconds, only the exact amount of time used by the player is added.
Timer Minutes cannot be more than 60 minutes and Timer Increment cannot be more than 60 seconds
Timer Minutes cannot be less than a minute and Timer Increment cannot be less than a second
Are you sure you want to\nstop the game timer.?
